run_camera_calibration_demo: run the demo to load camera calibration JSON and project a 3D world point to 2D window coordinates
review_from_json_camera_model: review the from_json function that constructs a CameraModel from a calibration JSON dictionary
summarize_world_to_window_projection: summarize the world_to_window method that projects 3D world coordinates to 2D image window coordinates
review_CameralModel_extrinsics: review the CameraModel class extrinsics property and update_extrinsics method for moving camera support
run_camera_model_instantiation: run the demo to instantiate an OpenCVCameraModel or OV62CameraModel from Nimble calibration JSON data
